variant.note: MG Pakistan's Cyberster page offers 'Single Motor' and 'Dual Motor'. This row is now the Single Motor only; the Dual Motor has its own row, mg-cyberster-gt-dual.

priceMax.note: PakNEV: PKR 27,000,000 ex-factory (Gari.pk agrees; PakWheels says 26,990,000). The PKR 29.9M top of the old span is the Dual Motor's, now on its own row.

realWorldRange.note: PakNEV real-world estimate 434 km (was EV Database's 425 km); PakNEV is this batch's primary reference.

consumption.note: PakNEV: 19.1 kWh/100 km, an estimate (was EV Database's 17.5).

warranty.value: Vehicle 5 years / 150,000 km; battery 8 years / 150,000 km.

notes.value: MG Cyberster GT with a single rear motor, one of two Cyberster trims MG Pakistan sells (the all-wheel-drive Dual Motor has its own page). 77 kWh battery (74.4 kWh usable), 250 kW (335 hp) and 475 Nm, rear-wheel drive, 0-100 km/h in 5.0 s, 195 km/h, 507 km WLTP; PakNEV estimates about 434 km in real-world use at 19.1 kWh/100 km. DC charging up to 144 kW with 10-80% in about 38 min (MG Pakistan); AC 11 kW (EV Database; PakNEV says 7.4 kW), about 8 h. 4,535 x 1,913 x 1,329 mm, 2,690 mm wheelbase, 249 L boot, two seats, electric scissor doors and soft top. Kerb weight 1,960 kg is the EU unladen figure (PakNEV gives 2,110 kg, which matches the Dual Motor). PKR 27,000,000. Warranty 5 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 150,000 km. Sources: MG Pakistan, PakNEV, EV Database, PakWheels.

realWorldRange.note: PakNEV, MCE Essence: real-world estimate 308 km.

notes.value: MG ZS EV MCE Essence, the smaller-battery ZS EV sold in Pakistan (the MCE Long Range has its own page). Per PakNEV: 51.1 kWh battery, 174 hp and 280 Nm, front-wheel drive, 360 km WLTP (about 308 km in real-world use, 14.2 kWh/100 km), 0-100 km/h in 8.6 s, 175 km/h. AC 7 kW; DC up to 75 kW with 10-80% in about 40 min. 4,323 x 1,809 x 1,649 mm, 2,585 mm wheelbase, 177 mm ground clearance, 1,570 kg, 5 seats. PKR 9,690,000. The ZS EV is no longer on MG Pakistan's website. Warranty 5 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 150,000 km. Source: PakNEV.
